descriptions.en: Wheel of Heaven Translation of Isaiah from the pointed Hebrew Masoretic text (Westminster Leningrad Codex, Public Domain). Phase 2 priority. Initial scope: chapter 6 (throne-room vision with the seraphim and the *kavod*-tradition vocabulary that parallels Ezekiel 1), chapters 24–27 (the 'Little Apocalypse' — cosmic-judgment material), chapter 53 (the suffering servant).
